blind.description: A brass or bronze hanging censer (thurible) consisting of a rounded, lobed/fluted metal bowl with a small bottom foot, a domed perforated lid, and four chains extending upward from loops on the bowl rim to converge at a single suspension ring at the top. The surfaces are continuous, solid, and cleanly modeled with an aged golden-brass metallic texture. It rests directly on its small base with no extra pedestal or ground slab, and has no flames or glowing effects.
blind.from_above: Looking straight down, the four chains radiate outwards from the central top ring in an X-shaped/cross formation over the circular rim and domed lid of the bowl.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 ft (45 cm) tall including chains and roughly 7–8 inches (18–20 cm) wide, about one-fourth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
